correctness.rationale: PASS: The incidence boundary has rank 9 for a connected 10-vertex graph, so 512 realizable even syndromes and a 64-word code. Independently enumerated all 2^15=32768 edge subsets from graph adjacency, updated every minimum boundary weight and tie count, and exactly recovered all nine (distance,tie) frequencies. Independently checked deep syndrome 1023 and its six size-five leaders. The proof identifies equal-weight minima with T-joins and the six perfect matchings; full finite enumeration is exhaustive, not an extrapolation.
